name: LeadOcean
summary: B2B people and company search, person and company enrichment, work and personal email, phone and reverse lookups, and bulk CSV exports.

api_key.description: a LeadOcean API key with the search and enrich scopes (create one in your LeadOcean account)

notes: Usage is counted in records, not requests: one person or company returned is one record, a search page of 25 rows costs 25, each enrichment or contact lookup costs 1 even when nothing is found. Add count=true to a search for the total in meta.total, capped at 100,000.
Keys have scopes, search and enrich; a missing scope answers 403 rather than an empty result.
Array filters in query strings are comma-separated; wrapping a value in [brackets] makes a keyword an exact match.
Search pages with meta.nextCursor (pass it back unchanged as cursor); one search pages through at most 10,000 rows by default.

Email status verified means LeadOcean itself sent to the address; catch_all_valid is a confirmed mailbox on a catch-all domain; untested is a supplier's word only. A search row carries has_email, email_status and email_type so you can check before spending a record.

Bulk export flow: leadocean.exports.create reserves records and returns an export id; poll leadocean.exports.get until it is done (409 from the download while running), then fetch leadocean.exports.download for the CSV, available for 7 days. Cap 50,000 rows per export.
Every response carries X-RateLimit-Limit and X-Quota-State headers; a 429 gives Retry-After.

endpoints.name: Get a person's current work email
endpoints.summary: One verified-or-catch-all work email at the person's current employer, or data null.

contact_id.description: The id a people-search row carries at meta.source_ids.person_id; send one of contact_id or person_id.

notes: Costs 1 record per call, found or not. data null means none that qualify, not that no work email exists.

endpoints.name: Get a person's personal emails
endpoints.summary: Every personal address held that is not known to be bad, as a list.

contact_id.description: The id a people-search row carries at meta.source_ids.person_id; send one of contact_id or person_id.

notes: Costs 1 record. Personal addresses are never verified by LeadOcean.

endpoints.name: Get a person's phone numbers
endpoints.summary: Every number held, best first, each with a type (mobile, direct, office).

contact_id.description: The id a people-search row carries at meta.source_ids.person_id; send one of contact_id or person_id.

notes: Costs 1 record. No do-not-call flag is published, so absence of one is not clearance.

endpoints.name: Find who holds an email or phone
endpoints.summary: The person behind an email address or phone number, plus its type, status and check date.

email.description: An address to look up; send this or phone, never both.

phone.description: A number in any common format; send this or email.

notes: Costs 1 record. For the full profile call leadocean.person.enrich.

endpoints.name: Enrich one person
endpoints.summary: A full profile for one person, by exactly one identifier.

person_id.description: The id a people-search row carries at meta.source_ids.person_id.

reveal_email.description: Include every email and phone held; at no extra charge. Default true when looked up by email, else false.

notes: Send exactly one identifier. Costs 1 record whether or not it finds anything.

endpoints.name: Search people
endpoints.summary: People matching profile and company filters, paged by cursor.

q.description: Free text over name, title, headline, summary, skills and company name.

title.description: Job title keywords; [brackets] for exact. Comma-separated.

jobFunction.description: Department or function of the current role. Comma-separated.

country.description: Country where the person is located. Comma-separated.

domain.description: Company domains the person works at. Comma-separated.

companyName.description: Company name phrases; [brackets] for exact. Comma-separated.

technologies.description: Technologies detected on the company website. Comma-separated.

keywords.description: Keywords in the person's own profile. Comma-separated.

hasEmail.description: Only people with (or, false, without) a known email.

hasPhone.description: Only people with (or without) a known phone.

reachable.description: Holding an email or phone; strict also requires a verified, catch_all_valid or catch_all email.

count.description: Also return the exact total in meta.total.

cursor.description: meta.nextCursor from the previous page, unchanged.

notes: Each person returned is one record. A subset of the filters is listed here; the OpenAPI file has many more (exclusions, funding, SIC and NAICS, facets, fields).

endpoints.name: Look up one company
endpoints.summary: A company profile by domain or LinkedIn URL.
notes: Send one of domain or linkedin_url. Costs 1 record.

endpoints.name: Search companies
endpoints.summary: Companies matching name, industry, size, revenue, funding, location and technology filters, paged by cursor.

q.description: Free text over company name and description.

name.description: Company name phrases; [brackets] for exact. Comma-separated.

keywords.description: Phrases across description, specialties, tags and name. Comma-separated.

hasMailableContacts.description: Companies with at least one person whose best email is verified, catch_all_valid or catch_all.

count.description: Also return the exact total in meta.total.

cursor.description: meta.nextCursor from the previous page, unchanged.

notes: Each company returned is one record. A subset of the filters is listed here.

endpoints.name: List the people held at a company
endpoints.summary: Thin person records at a company domain, paged; contact points are not included.
notes: One record billed per person returned. Enrich a person for email or phone.

endpoints.name: Start a bulk CSV export of people
endpoints.summary: Starts an async export of people matching a filter set, up to 50,000 rows.

filters.description: A people search filter set: every /v1/people/search filter except cursor, limit, count and facets.

columns.description: Column ids from /v1/exports/columns, in order. Omit to use a preset.

preset.description: A named column set; full is the default.

reveal.description: What to reveal; derived from the columns when omitted.

notes: A read over POST: it starts a job that only produces a file. It reserves up to limit records at once and bills each row written. Poll leadocean.exports.get, then fetch leadocean.exports.download.

endpoints.name: Get an export's status
endpoints.summary: Status and progress of one export, with a signed download link when ready.

endpoints.name: Download an export as CSV
notes: 409 while the export is still running; 410 once the file has expired (kept 7 days).

endpoints.name: Cancel an export
endpoints.summary: Cancels a queued or running export; rows already written stay billed and downloadable.

endpoints.name: Get account, plan and records left
endpoints.summary: Plan, records left, subscription state, export windows and rate.

endpoints.name: Get records used this month
endpoints.summary: Records used this month, plan and per-day totals.
